description:
Chloé unveils its Winter 2026 campaign by Chemena Kamali, photographed by Inez & Vinoodh.​
​
The campaign unfolds through shifting light and untamed landscapes, where savoir-faire, natural elements and instinctive femininity converge in an expression of humanity, freedom and connection. Folkloric elements and the human touch come together to express a vision that is at once timeless, intuitive and deeply rooted in the spirit of Chloé.​
​
“For this campaign, I wanted to express devotion through women, the vastness of open landscapes, and craftsmanship. Nature brings us back to instinct, freedom and connection. In that openness, femininity unfolds with untamed strength and togetherness.“ Chemena Kamali, Creative Director of Chloé​
​
Creative Director: Chemena Kamali
Photographed by Inez and Vinoodh
Styling: Elodie David Touboul
Casting: Piergiorgio Del Moro
Hair: Anthony Turner
Makeup: Yadim

description:
For the exhibition « Hidden Treasures: 250 Years of Franco-American Luxury Stories, » now on in New York, Chloé commissioned a film, directed by Lisa Rovner and narrated by Pat Cleveland, that illuminates the creative exchange between Karl Lagerfeld and his iconic American bande d’amis in the 1970s.

In the decade that followed Karl Lagerfeld’s arrival at Chloé, the Maison experienced a meteoric rise — shaped in part by this dynamic circle of young New Yorkers. Antonio Lopez and his partner, Juan Ramos, alongside models Pat Cleveland, Donna Jordan, and Jane Forth, brought their New York energy, spontaneity, and instinctive style to Paris — an energy and spirit that fed directly into his designs.

Presented by the Comité Colbert, « Hidden Treasures: 250 Years of Franco-American Luxury Stories » runs from May 26 to 31, 2026, at The Shed, Hudson Yards, New York.

Film by @LisaRovner
Narrated by @PatCleveland
Featuring @Hourcade.Patrick
With Antonio Lopez, Juan Ramos, Pat Cleveland, Donna Jordan, Jane Forth, Corey Grant Tippin, Jay Johnson, Sergio Arena, Patti D’arbanville, Cathee Dahmen and Karl Lagerfeld
Archives: @the_antonio_archives @kinolibrary @leslieannesmith.art @JeanLucephoto
title: Karl Lagerfeld and Antonio Lopez at Chloé in the 1970s
